summary: Nexa Resources filed a Form 6-K providing an operational update on the gradual resumption of its Cajamarquilla zinc smelter in Peru after a May 13 incident. The electrolysis lines are fully operational, one casting line is back, and the remaining two lines are expected to restart by mid-June. The company estimates a production impact of ~7kt in Q2 2026 (~2% of annual output), which is expected to be recovered in H2; 2026 sales guidance remains unchanged. No material financial impact is anticipated. This is a routine operational status report, not a special situation. What to watch: cause investigation and any further production disruptions.
